summary_rules: per key: claude-api rows first (quote-gated); regex rows only when no claude-api row exists for the key (basis 'regex-fallback', confidence-high and the quote names the control); headline = low-density residential buckets only (R2_dwelling_house incl. unmarked general-residential rows, R2_dual_occupancy) — HCA, site-specific, mixed-use/business-centre, rural and other chapters are excluded and appear only in summary_by_context; candidates come from the headline DCP when it has any for the key, else from every document; value = mode of (value, unit) after de-duplicating copies of the same DCP; ties -> plainer context, then the conservative figure (smaller for setbacks and maxima, larger for landscaped/deep-soil/open-space area, lot size, lot width); setbacks are metres only. A heuristic headline, not a finding — review the quote/page before use.

provenance.review_status_note: auto = quote-gated, not human-checked; confidence 'high' = table row / prescriptive wording or LLM-extracted, 'low' = descriptive sentence; DCPs guide rather than bind (EP&A Act s 4.15(3A))
